description:
A collection of windows feature update profiles

TIP: Lists Windows feature update profiles (Intune > Devices > Windows updates > Feature updates): the Windows version a group is held on or moved to. Each has displayName, featureUpdateVersion (e.g. 'Windows 11, version 24H2'), rolloutSettings {offerStartDateTimeInUTC, offerEndDateTimeInUTC, offerIntervalInDays}, installLatestWindows10OnWindows11IneligibleDevice, installFeatureUpdatesOptional, endOfSupportDate, deployableContentDisplayName. A feature update profile overrides the feature deferral of the device's Windows Update for Business ring, so read both when rings seem to disagree. Use $expand=assignments for target groups. Supports $filter, $top, $skip, $select, $expand, $count.

excludeResponse.description: Exclude the full response body and only return success or failure
